scope: Keep the mobile public renderer's computed height and minimum height in parity with the resolved Inspector/Page Model values through edit, draft Save, reload, Publish, desktop preservation, and inheritance reset.

finding.source: public/assets/page-renderer.js style() resolves the active responsive value and emits it inline. The public mobile fallback used height:auto!important and min-height:80px!important on ordinary nodes, which overrode those resolved declarations in the cascade.
finding.impact: The mobile Inspector/Canvas could show a saved or inherited height/minHeight while the published page rendered auto/80px instead.
finding.scope_limit: The mobile minimum-height fallback applies to top-level non-layout-managed nodes; the height fallback also applies to their ordinary child nodes.

implementation: The renderer now emits --editor-mobile-height and --editor-mobile-min-height from the same validated, responsive-resolved values as its inline styles.
The static visual-page.html fallback and renderer-injected fallback both use those variables with their existing auto/80px defaults.
The visual-page renderer URL uses cache key 20261027-mobile-dimensions.
Added a Chromium lifecycle regression for inherited desktop mobile values, mobile edits, draft Save, Editor reload, explicit Publish, desktop isolation, and mobile inheritance reset.
